{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute the number of new customers reached by paid search
n_total = len(filtered_df)

# Compute the number of converted customers in this group
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute the fraction who converted
fraction_converted = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f"n_total = {n_total}")
print(f"n_converted = {n_converted}")
print(f"fraction_converted = {fraction_converted}")"}
